name: Nicolaes Pieterszoon Berchem

summary.text: Nicolaes Pieterszoon Berchem was a highly esteemed and prolific Dutch Golden Age painter of pastoral landscapes, populated with mythological or biblical figures, but also of a number of allegories and genre pieces.
summary.title: Nicolaes Pieterszoon Berchem
